editorial:
Imagine being ten years old and suddenly feeling like your own parents are the bad guys. That is exactly what happens in this creepy story. You follow a young girl who starts seeing things that aren't there and believes a mean spirit is controlling her mom and dad. The vibe is really tense and makes you feel her panic as she creates a scary make-believe world to deal with her fear. It feels like a nightmare that you just cannot wake up from, and it keeps you guessing about what is actually real.

The acting is the best part because the little girl makes you truly feel for her. While the middle part of the movie slows down a bit, the ending hits hard and keeps you on your toes. If you like stories that mess with your head, you will love this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the creepy details in the background. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move so you can rewatch those tricky clues.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that there was never a real spirit. The girl was actually struggling with a mental break and imagined the danger to cope with a family secret. The twist reveals that her parents were trying to get her help, not hurt her. It ends with her finally getting the medical care she needs, though the line between her fantasy and reality stays blurry until the very last shot.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and twist endings.
